writtenAt: 2026-11-04, before test3 or any new training note exists
approvedBy: Nell: 'Proceed please.' (2026-11-04) on the plan of 2026-11-03
what: Retrain the Qwen3.5-0.8B routing tune on the original 5,629 notes plus new Brazilian Portuguese notes, same hyperparameters as s08b (retention_weight 0), and decide whether it replaces s08b in the routing lane.

data.test3: A new Brazilian Portuguese test set written by Claude Opus 5.5 with registers and planted-instruction forms disjoint from training, kept only where the authored label, Jev 1.14 and Claude Haiku 5.5 agree, then frozen and hashed into eval/MANIFEST.json before any new training note is generated.
data.train: 1,500-2,000 new Brazilian Portuguese notes from gen_train.py (Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5 alternating), deduplicated against every frozen set including test3, kept only on three-way agreement, targets = Jev probabilities.

gate.measuredIn: Chrome, browser_eval.mjs --skip-strategy, the q4f16_1 build, same machine
all: no other set (easy, hard, injection, held, held-inj, production, test2-en, test2-inj) falls by more than 1 case against s08b's Chrome run
test3 total >= s08b's test3 total, measured on the same day
gate.ifPass: s08b-pt replaces s08b in the routing lane (same repo, new pinned revision).
gate.ifFail: the 2B tune (250/257, test2-pt-BR 29/30) takes the routing lane and the expansion is dropped.
